_doc: NEGATIVE CONTROL — DELIBERATELY WRONG. Claims £270,000 for a 31 December 2019 death. SI 2020/33 was not yet in force and earlier figures are not modelled, so the rule must return NeedsHuman, and the harness (which requires the Computed arm) must go RED. scripts/test-l6-temporal-oracle.sh PASSES only if this exits 1. If it ever goes green, the rule is presenting a figure it does not have authority for.
statute: Administration of Estates Act 1925 s.46(1)(i) Table Case (2)(B) and Schedule 1A; SI 2020/33 (Fixed Net Sum Order 2020); SI 2023/758 (Fixed Net Sum Order 2023)

cases.label: before-modelled-window-death-2019-12-31
cases.citation: WRONG ON PURPOSE: £270,000 applies only from 6 February 2020 (SI 2020/33); before that the rule routes to a human.
